Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We finalized our pilot run cadence and confirmed an internal launch goal for the week of May 10. We attached our traffic projection (LumenCare_launch_forecast_v1.xlsx) but high level:

- Peak concurrent requests: ~420 reqs/min during peak hour (conservative)
- Anticipated average QPS: 4.5 sustained during business hours
- Burst windows: up to ~1k reqs/min during notification events (3–5 minute spikes)

Can Redwood provision a temporary ingress uplift for the pilot (May 10–21) and a short pre-launch dry run for 1 hour where we simulate peak traffic? We also need a quick confirmation on recommended model variant and any routing/batching knobs that will materially change latency.

Attachments: [Attachment: LumenCare_launch_forecast_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

Rishi —

Thanks for the ping and the forecast, this is helpful. Recommendation summary below based on their burst profile and latency sensitivity:

Model/config:
- Recommend: redwood-open-6b-rt (balanced latency/quality). If cost is tight, redwood-open-4b-q8 is acceptable with an expected +30–45ms median latency.
- Quantization: Q4_K_Mixed for 6b; for 4b use q8_0.
- Enable prefix (request) caching and aggressive KV eviction window set to 12h for pilot.

Routing/serving notes:
- Continuous batching bucket target = 20–40ms to keep latency <250ms p50 under steady QPS. For 1k/min spikes we recommend a temporary routing policy that routes ~30% of traffic to a lower-cost 4b variant to preserve headroom. See attached stub for routing policy.

Quota ask (tentative):
- Increase ingress quota to 600 reqs/min sustained, 1,200 reqs/min burst (3–5 min windows).
- Increase concurrent connections by +40 for their API keys during the pilot window.

Risk/ops:
- If we keep them on hosted shared capacity, we should provision the temporary uplift at least 72 hours before dry run. If they want absolute isolation, we will need Dedicated capacity (lead time 7–10 business days).

I attached a short routing policy stub to illustrate fallback to 4b during spikes. Marissa, please confirm if QuotaOps can make the provisional increase; Neha, flag if Dedicated is being discussed when you respond.

Attachment: [Attachment: routing_policy_stub.json (json)]

—Karthik
